statement: Nvidia publicly denied a report that it would ship a China-specific LPU by year-end, saying it has no LPU sales in China and no China-specific LPU on its roadmap.
why: The denial keeps Nvidia's China accelerator revenue path closed, following the CEO's statement that Nvidia had largely conceded China to Huawei.

impact.mechanism: With no China-specific product in the roadmap, export-control-constrained China demand does not convert into Nvidia revenue and shifts to domestic Chinese suppliers.

evidence.excerpt: The reporting in The Information on Nvidia's LPU is incorrect. We have no LPU sales in the China market today, and no China-specific LPU product in our roadmap.
CEO Jensen Huang stated in May 2026 that Nvidia had 'largely conceded' China's AI chip market to Huawei Technologies.

confidence.basis: Secondary wire coverage carrying a direct company denial; reports conflict and no filing was fetched.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend flat -> flat); sources: Reuters (via Investing.com), Tom's Hardware
